title: 49ers bring Khalil Herbert back; Patrick Taylor Jr. heads to the IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers bring Khalil Herbert back; Patrick Taylor Jr. heads to the IR
sources.description: The 49ers won’t have Christian McCaffrey tonight, which means we’ll get our first look at Kaelon Black. So it'll be Black, Sincere McCormick, Zamir White, and Herbert.
